column1: # *** A TENTH LERENA DISPENSATION, AND ANOTHER CHILD OF AVELINO. ***
# Catedral Basilica de Montevideo, 3 February 1892. Officiant: Presbitero Don Martin Perez, by
# licence of the Cura Parroco; signed Rafael Yeregui. Ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9B7-R32C-K, full-text transcript
# read 14 September 2026.
field
Groom
column2: *** "Don ALFREDO GERENA, natural de esta Republica, soltero, de TREINTA Y CINCO anos de edad, hijo legitimo de Don AVELINO LORENA y Dona AMBROSIA TRAIBEL" ***
column3: *** A SON OF AVELINO, born about 1857 - a BROTHER of Josefa Lerena Traibel. *** Note the two spellings in one sentence: the groom GERENA, his father LORENA.

column1: Bride
column2: Dona HERMENEGILDA CAROLINA GAVAZZO, de la misma nacionalidad y estado, de treinta anos, hija legitima de Don Geronimo Gavazzo y Dona Carolina Juarez

column1: *** The dispensation ***
column2: *** "dispensados por el Ilustrisimo y Rmo Senor Obispo Diocesano Monsenor Doctor Don MARIANO SOLER del impedimento canonico de parentesco de TERCER GRADO DE CONSANGUINIDAD CON ATINGENCIA AL SEGUNDO, por linea colateral desigual" ***
column3: *** THE BRIDE AND GROOM WERE COUSINS. *** Granted personally by Mariano Soler - the first Archbishop of Montevideo, and the most senior churchman in the country.

column1: Witnesses
column2: fueron testigos Don Carlos Navia y *** Dona AMBROSIA TRAIBEL ***
column3: *** His mother stood witness at his wedding, so she was alive in February 1892. ***

column1: # ================== WHY THIS IS A TENTH, AND WHY IT WAS MISSED ==================
# This archive's sweep of the Montevideo dispensation register recorded EIGHT Lerena dispensations
# and concluded that every Lerena in it married OUT. A NINTH was found earlier today - Ema Sixta's,
# missed because the formula "LERENA FELIGRESA" cannot see a compound surname.
# *** THIS IS A TENTH, AND IT WAS MISSED TWO WAYS AT ONCE. ***
#   1. The groom is written *** GERENA ***, not Lerena - a seventh spelling for this family, after
#      Lerena, Llerena, Lorena, Serena, Lerina and Sancio. A search on LERENA cannot reach him.
#   2. The dispensation clause comes BEFORE the names, so "Lerena el impedimento" - the sweep's other
#      formula, which assumes the surname precedes the word - cannot match either.
# *** SO THE HEADLINE FINDING OF THAT FILE IS NOW TWICE BREACHED IN ONE DAY *** and its count of
# eight is certainly low. What survives is narrower and still worth something: no LERENA-LERENA
# dispensation has been found. This one is a Lerena marrying a GAVAZZO.
# *** AND IT SHOWS THE FAMILY DID MARRY KIN. *** Third degree with atingencia to the second is a
# first-cousins-once-removed sort of relationship. The standing question behind this archive's whole
# search is whether Juan Carlos Lerena and Maria Lerena were kin; this does not answer it, but it
# establishes that in this generation, in this family, cousin marriage happened and was dispensed at
# the highest level.
# *** THIS FILE SAID 'FULL-TEXT TRANSCRIPT READ' FOR A WEEK, WHICH MEANS A MACHINE READ IT. ***
# The image is film *** 007713383, image 02601, folio 340 ***, and it was opened on 21 September
# 2026 because a DIFFERENT record - Hermenegilda's own death registration of 1940 - spelled her
# surname in a way this file did not.
# *** THE ACT, READ OFF THE PLATE: ***
#   'presente Contrajo Don ALFREDO LERENA, soltero, de TREINTA Y CINCO anos de edad, hijo
#    [legitimo de Don Avelino Lerena] y Dona AMBROSIA TRAIBEL. Con Dona HERMENEGILDA [CAROLINA
#    GAVAZZO], de la misma nacionalidad y estado, de TREINTA [anos, hija legitima de Don]
#    GERONIMO GAVAZZO y Dona CAROLINA SUAREZ ... NAVIA y Dona AMBROSIA TRAIBEL. Por verdad...'
# *** GAVAZZO, NOT GAVARRO. SUAREZ, NOT JUAREZ. *** Three register rows carried the machine's
# reading. See data/corrections.tsv.
# *** WHAT THE IMAGE CONFIRMS that the transcript already had right: *** Alfredo at THIRTY-FIVE,
# which is exact against a birth of 2 October 1856; the bride at THIRTY; the dispensation of
# consanguinity in the third degree with atingencia to the second; and Ambrosia Traibel standing
# witness where a father would be, because Avelino had been dead sixteen months.
# ================= AND HER DEATH, WHICH THE ARCHIVE HAD NEVER LOOKED FOR =================
# *** HERMENEGILDA GAVAZZO DE LERENA DIED AT MONTEVIDEO ON 20 JUNE 1940 ***, at R. Masini 3273,
# certificate 632, before Jose M. Reyes Corvalan, Oficial del Estado Civil. Film 008166249 image
# 01900, IMAGE READ. *** 'de estado VIUDA' ***, and *** 'a consecuencia de FRACTURA DEL CUELLO DEL
# FEMUR' *** - a broken hip, which for a woman of about seventy-eight in 1940 is usually the end.
# *** SO ALFREDO JUSTINIANO DIED BETWEEN FEBRUARY 1892 AND JUNE 1940 ***, which is the first thing
# this archive has ever known about the end of his life.
# =========== AND THE INDEX OF THAT DEATH ACT IS A CATALOGUE OF ITS OWN FAILURES ===========
# FamilySearch indexes this record with THREE CHILDREN attached to Alfredo and Hermenegilda.
# *** THERE ARE NO CHILDREN ON THE ACT. *** The three are:
#   'Jose M Reyes Lerena'              -> JOSE M. REYES CORVALAN, *** THE REGISTRAR ***, whose
#                                         name follows the words 'ante mi'.
#   'Anic Mesuch M. Misuch McCallan'   -> people from the ADJACENT act, No. 633, which concerns
#   'Carolina Ra - 117 Callan'            a family with English names - John Burrows, Annie
#                                         Campbell - and bled across the column rule.
# The same entry gives her birth as *** 1934 *** for a woman who died in 1940, her nationality as
# *** MEXICANA ***, her age as *** 'cu anos de edad' ***, and her birthplace as *** 'Minteridco' ***.
# *** EVERY FIELD IS WRONG EXCEPT ONE PAIR, AND THAT PAIR IS WHY SHE WAS FOUND: *** the maternal
# grandparents, indexed 'Geronima Gara' and 'Carolina Suarez'. Those are GERONIMO GAVAZZO and
# CAROLINA SUAREZ, and this archive already held them. *** An index can be worthless in every
# field a reader would check and still carry the one pair of names that identifies a person. ***
